vast-ai-epyc-7c13-t0126.description: Vast.ai instance 37767708 (AMD EPYC 7C13 64-Core, 32 effective vCPUs, 64 GB RAM, 1x Tesla V100 idle, Virginia US, $0.1844/hr total = $0.1733/hr GPU + $0.0111/hr storage for the 40 GB disk). Final cost reported by the NSGA-II cost_watchdog at the end of the gen 60 run was $0.9621 (final_cost_usd from nsga2_driver exit summary). Includes the full lifecycle: instance creation + apt installs + pip dependencies (NEURON 8.2.7, pymoo 0.6.1.6, dill, numpy, pandas, scipy, matplotlib, pydantic, tqdm, sklearn) + t0080 MOD compile + t0024 DSGC MOD compile + t0126 code SCP + Carter-Bean smoke-gate + NSGA-II run (60-gen ceiling reached cleanly with NSGA2_EXIT=0, pop=96, n_eval_seeds=3, n_directions=2, single seed 8929) + post-run downloads. Wallclock for the NSGA-II run alone was 18,777 s (5.22 h) as reported by the driver exit log; the cost_watchdog ran continuously over that span at $0.1844/hr. The orchestrator's step 010_teardown destroys the instance after this wrap-up completes.

note: Pre-aggregator cost estimate from the NSGA-II cost_watchdog's continuous accumulator.
